title: Camera firmware versions MV 6.1.2 changelog

announcements.post_subject: A new stable camera firmware is now available on Mon, 04 Nov 2024

Bug fixes: Resolved an issue causing delayed access to historical video when Cloud Archive is enabled on MV12(s)/MV2/MV22(x)/MV32/MV52/MV72(x).
Resolved an issue that was preventing impacted cameras from storing new video
Notice: When configured for this version, MV21 & MV71 devices will run MV4.15

html:
Camera firmware versions MV 6.1.2 changelog

Bug fixes

  • Resolved an issue causing delayed access to historical video when Cloud Archive is enabled on MV12(s)/MV2/MV22(x)/MV32/MV52/MV72(x).
  • Resolved an issue that was preventing impacted cameras from storing new video

Notice

  • When configured for this version, MV21 & MV71 devices will run MV4.15
